Trades left: -

Buy

Sell

Buy spends that share of your remaining cash. Sell sells that share of your coins (100% closes the position). Each press is one trade.

The chart shows the server's price readings as an index: the same candles for both players from the first one, and every trade fills at a price on it. Green candles rose, red ones fell. Buys are green markers and sells red; the ring around each picture says whose trade it is (yours blue, your opponent's yellow).

Before you queue

    

    

      If you make no trades during the match, you lose your stake.
      If neither player trades, both get their stake back minus the 2.5% house cut.
      Your wallet will then be asked to open or join a match on chain, which moves your stake
      from your balance into the match.

    Create a new wallet for PonsStars
    
  
    
    
    Read this first. This makes a brand-new Solana wallet inside this browser.
      You will see its 12-word secret phrase once. Anyone who has the phrase controls the wallet.
      PonsStars never sees or keeps it: if you lose it, nobody can recover the wallet.
      Write it on paper; do not screenshot it or paste it anywhere. Test networks only.

    Balance
    
  
    One escrow balance for all your matches: deposit once, play as many matches as it covers,
     and withdraw whenever you are not in a match. Stakes leave it when a match starts and payouts land back in it
     as soon as the match is settled. The house pays the match accounts' small deposits.
